description: Each college's income is divided by the total of all income records, whether or not they link to a college.

c.request: Linking each income record through the member who brought it in to that member's major, show each college with its total income amount and what fraction of the total income that represents, without rounding. Each college's income is divided by the total of all income records, whether or not they link to a college.
c.sql: SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS income_fraction FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college;

b.request: Each college's income summed via member → major, divided by the total income across all income records (including those with no member or no major link), shown as a fraction of total income without rounding
b.sql: SELECT m.college, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS income_fraction FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college;

a.request: Link each income record to the member who brought it in and to that member's major, dropping any income that does not link up. For each college of those majors, show the college, the total income amount, and that total as a fraction of the total amount of all income records (including income not matched to any college), without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS income_fraction FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college;

d.request: For each college, what is its total income (income records linked through the member who brought them in to that member's major), and what fraction of the total of all income records does that college's income represent, counting income records that don't link to any college in the denominator? Give the amounts and fractions without rounding.
d.sql: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_all_income FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.college;
